comparison: Passes the 3-task cheap smoke screen and beats r3-negctrl-unreg-adam on ring, shift, and rail-escape endurance, while trailing t4-arch-v3 (3/3 14k passes) and unified-v3 (2/3 14k passes) on 100-mode accuracy.
conclusion: On the untouched Tier-3 long-horizon holdout view (seed 0, zero tuning, 3822.6s), empf-v8 passed 10/18 tasks (two_pole 0.9583, unused_token_hold, ae_gan_hold, clockfree_audit, zero_tanh_smoke, zero_tanh_rail_escape 0.0026 MAE, mode_hold 1.0000 hq, ring_hold conv=1400, uninterrupted 7500-step ring_extension 300/300 checks, and target_shift_recovery 81/81 live checks min_hq=0.9995), failed all three 100-mode tasks (grid100 prec=0.3460, rotated100 0.3582, staggered100 0.2960, gating all three 14k continuations), and hit the 900s timeout INCOMPLETE on five_word_joint_smoke (gating five_word_joint_hold).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Evaluate frozen empf-v8 without tuning under protocol seed 0 on the Round-3 Tier-3 long-horizon holdout suite (14,000-update fresh-process native continuations grid100_14k/rotated100_14k/staggered100_14k, 7,500-update uninterrupted ring_extension, 4,000-update five_word_joint_hold, target_shift_recovery, zero_tanh_rail_escape, and 3-task cheap smoke screen).
